findings.description: A gateway route is configured with no authentication and forwards to endpoints that are not login endpoints, so the gateway is not acting as an authentication boundary.

mitigation: Set auth: required on the route, or split public paths (login) into their own route.

routes:
  - prefix: /api/payments
    service: payment-service
    auth: required      # was: none

findings.title: Public entry serves the API without TLS
findings.description: The public entry (Ingress, load balancer, Istio Gateway or published port) has no TLS, so Authorization headers and personal data sent through it can be read or replayed on the network. The evidence says how many public endpoints carried them in this capture.
findings.detail: published port (docker compose) web serves the API over plain HTTP
findings.recommendation: Enable TLS on published port (docker compose) web.
mitigation: Terminate TLS at the ingress (tls: section + certificate) and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
Send Strict-Transport-Security so browsers never fall back to HTTP.
findings.snippet:
spec:
  tls:
    - hosts: [api.example.com]
      secretName: api-tls

findings.title: No resource limits on an internet-reachable service
findings.description: The container has no CPU/memory limits, so one expensive request pattern can starve the node and every service on it.
findings.detail: web has no resource limits and is reachable from internet
factors: likelihood +1: service reachable from the internet
findings.recommendation: Add resources.limits to web.
mitigation: Set resources.limits and requests for every container.
Add rate limits at the gateway for expensive operations.

findings.title: Container can run as root
findings.description: Nothing stops the container process from running as UID 0 (runAsUser: 0, or no runAsNonRoot).
findings.detail: web does not set runAsNonRoot
factors: likelihood +1: service reachable from the internet
findings.recommendation: Run web as a non-root user.
mitigation: Set runAsNonRoot: true and a non-zero runAsUser.
Build images with a non-root USER.
